title: FlowDiffOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow diff --json`: the objects of the draft that differ from the active flow.

applied.description: The commit that applied the active flow the draft is compared with; absent if the project has no flow, and then every object of the draft is added.

changes.description: Changed objects: the common rules first, then scenarios, stages, parts and subagents of the project, each kind by identifier. Not empty: without changes there is no draft.

object.description: Kind of the object: common for the common rules of the flow, scenario, stage, part or agent for a subagent of the project.

id.description: Identifier of the object; absent for the common rules.

sync.description: What the synchronization before the command did; present only when there is something to tell.
